title: Blender Review Flags for iterative work
author: Cubey42
selftext:
After going back and forth while working on a model I had an idea that spawned from figuring out the model could understand the 3d cursor. 

A plugin that works with your assistant to help on making corrections when using AI in blender. you can position the perspective and add a flag at your 3d cursor which will give the model better direction. you can iterate on a project to increase its quality (fix this material, add another joint to the arm, fix this mesh, change the texture) . 

its fully vibecoded from yesterday so if there's issues, I'll probably fix them
